mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.device_id AS deviceId, a.attachment_type AS attachmentType, a.file_name AS fileName, a.file_path AS filePath, a.file_size AS fileSize, a.create_by AS createBy, a.create_time AS createTime, a.update_by AS updateBy, a.update_time AS updateTime, CASE WHEN u.realname IS NOT NULL AND u.realname <> '' THEN u.realname ELSE a.create_by END AS uploadByName FROM device_attachment a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username = a.create_by WHERE a.device_id = #{deviceId} ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
